name: MZR Order Tracking
author: Meshut Digital

sections.description:
MZR Order Tracking transforms your WooCommerce store into a complete shipment tracking system. Easily add tracking information to orders, manage multiple shipping carriers, and automatically notify customers.

Key Features

✔ Shipping Provider Management
– Add unlimited shipping carriers (DHL, UPS, FedEx, etc.)
– Custom tracking URLs with {TRACKINGCODE} placeholder
– Enable/disable providers with one click

✔ Order Tracking Made Easy
– Add tracking numbers directly from order edit screen
– Set shipping dates with user-friendly date picker
– Bulk add tracking to multiple orders

✔ Customer Communication
– Automatic email notifications with tracking links
– Customizable email templates with dynamic placeholders
– Optional display in customer account area

✔ Flexible Configuration
– Enable/disable entire tracking system
– Control email notification settings
– Choose whether to show tracking in customer accounts
sections.installation:
1. Upload the mzr-order-tracking folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Shipping → Order Tracking
  4. Configure your shipping providers and settings
sections.faq:
How do I add a new shipping provider?

Go to WooCommerce Settings → Shipping → Order Tracking and use the “Add Provider” button. Enter the provider name and tracking URL pattern.

Can customers track their orders?

Yes! Tracking information appears in:
– Order confirmation emails (if enabled)
– My Account → Order Details page
– With direct tracking links to carrier websites

How are email notifications sent?

When you add a tracking number to an order, the system automatically sends an email to the customer with the tracking information if notifications are enabled.

Can I use this with other shipping plugins?

Yes, MZR Order Tracking works alongside most WooCommerce shipping plugins. It simply adds tracking functionality regardless of shipping method.
